summary: @servicetitan/startup-utils preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes a 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that unconditionally executes a bundled 727 KB heavily-obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js` using the Bun runtime. If Bun is not already installed on the machine, setup.mjs downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13), extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js`. The obfuscated payload is not referenced from the package's legitimate entry (`dist/index.js`) or its TypeScript sources, is not derived from any shipped source, and uses rotated-numeric string arrays, `_0xNNNN`-style identifiers, custom alphabet decoders, and `with` statements chosen to defeat AST-based scanners. The library's stated surface only exports `getVersionMismatches`/`isCompatible`, which has no functional need for a second language runtime or an opaque 727 KB blob. The dropper fires automatically on every `npm install`, executing attacker-controlled code on the installer's host outside Node's visibility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
